#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.
Do you want to be the driving spirit behind everything we do?
As a Senior Director International Tax (f/m/div) on our Corporate Functions team become the heart of our organization by developing strategies, refining processes, and implementing initiatives that empower our business to thrive.
Are you in?

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

In this role, you will lead the International Tax Team and hold global responsibility for the Group's international tax strategy, the tax planning and optimization of the legal Group and financing structure (particularly with cross-border implications), as well as tax efficiency and tax risk management for M&A activities and intra-group restructurings.

- Provide professional and line leadership for the International Tax Team within Infineon's Group Tax Department- Advise central functions and business units worldwide on international tax matters and developments, and manage all internal and external stakeholders during the implementation of measures- Hold global responsibility for financing and dividend strategies- Ensure tax efficiency and tax risk management for the entire Infineon Group, particularly for M&A projects and corporate restructurings- Lead interdisciplinary and multi-functional projects- Drive the automation and digitalization of processes within the department

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

You demonstrate strong judgment and assertiveness, enabling you to make and defend strategic decisions. Your excellent communication skills and confident, persuasive demeanor allow you to build a stable network at all levels. You understand the strengths of your team members, deploy them accordingly, and support their development potential, with a keen sensitivity for cultural differences and working styles.

- A degree in business administration or law (or equivalent), and a passed qualification as a Tax Advisor (Steuerberaterexamen), Specialist Lawyer in International Tax Law (Examen als Fachanwalt für internationales Steuerrecht), or comparable qualification in Germany or abroad- Possess at least 10 years of professional experience in consulting (ideally Big Four), in a comparable role in corporate finance, or in the tax department of a multinational corporation- Have extensive experience advising other multinational corporations on national and international tax planning- Demonstrate long-standing experience in international M&A transactions (including Tax Due Diligence, SPA Tax Advice, structuring, and integration)- Possess profound knowledge of transformation law and transformation tax law (Umwandlungs- und Umwandlungssteuerrecht), as well as international tax law (Außensteuerrecht), corporate income tax law (Körperschaftsteuerrecht), and trade tax law (Gewerbesteuerrecht)- Be able to accurately assess the impact of tax planning measures on other functions (e.g., Supply Chain, Value Flow, Accounting, Legal, etc.)- Preferably possess basic industry knowledge and fundamental knowledge of corporate law (Gesellschaftsrecht), and enjoy working in multinational teams- Have excellent communication skills in German and English, both spoken and written

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.
Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.
Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.
Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Division of Soft-Tissue Sarcoma at the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center (KiTZ) - a joint institution of the Heidelberg University Hospital and the German Cancer Research Center - is seeking, starting between December 2026 and January 2027, a Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager.

Your Tasks

We are a friendly and motivated laboratory with German and international researchers working to understand tumor biology and generate new models to help find treatments for children and adults with sarcoma. The candidate’s tasks will comprise lab management, cell culture, plasmid preps, support in various molecular biology techniques and training of new laboratory members on specifc tasks when required. Occasional mouse work may be required. Routine animal work is covered by a dedicated technician, with the successful candidate only expected to assist during periods of absence or in exceptional circumstances. While the position involves both administrative and laboratory work, there is some flexibility in the balance between these two areas, depending on the successful candidate’s interests. The candidate will work together with other members of the laboratory and will be trained in the various tasks.

Your Profile

The ideal candidate should:

- Be motivated, responsible, and well organised
- Have completed vocational training as a biological laboratory technician or hold a comparable qualification
- Have experience in cell culture and standard molecular biology techniques
- Have basic experience in handling mice, ideally hold a FELASA certificate
- Be willing to train technical trainees and early-career scientists in specific laboratory techniques
- Have a working knowledge of English and German
- Have good communication skills and the ability to document laboratory work accurately

WHAT MAKES THIS POSITION SPECIAL

- Training in a range of laboratory techniques
- An interesting and varied role, with the opportunity to contribute actively, alongside the wider research group, to laboratory organisation and the group’s future development
- Friendly, collaborative, and international working environment
- Workplace in the new KiTZ building and access to the modern, state-of-the-art infrastructure of the DKFZ campus
- Opportunities for continuing education, professional development, and career progression

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Dr. Ana Banito
Phone: +49 (0)6221/42-1581

​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: November 4, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In this role, you are responsible for the efficient and accurate preparation of quotations for the global surge arrester market. Your proposals are based on customer-specific technical requirements, established product solutions, and applicable framework agreements.
You support both internal and external stakeholders by providing timely clarifications and ensuring a high level of customer service throughout the quotation process. In addition, you are responsible for the accurate processing and booking of customer orders, thereby ensuring a seamless transition from sales to execution.
Through your structured, process-oriented approach, you enable regional sales colleagues to further develop business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. The quality, accuracy, and reliability of your work form the foundation for the efficient execution of downstream operational processes.
You collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization, actively engage with adjacent functions on complex topics, communicate transparently, and contribute to the continuous improvement of existing processes by constructively challenging established ways of working.
Your daily work is supported by SAP, including a powerful integrated configuration tool, as well as the Microsoft Office suite.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Commitment to delivering high customer satisfaction, exceptional service quality, and sustainable business growth
* Active contribution to process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Support and promotion of a collaborative learning culture and knowledge sharing environment
* Customer-centric service excellence and responsiveness to evolving market requirements
* Ownership and accountability for operational effectiveness and business success
* Dedication to advancing the transition toward a CO₂-free and sustainable energy future

What You Bring

* Advanced technical understanding of energy transmission and distribution components and applications
* Strong commitment to professional development, continuous learning, and effective communication
* Rapid comprehension of complex topics and proficiency in utilizing IT tools, including SAP and MS Office
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities within cross-functional and international environments
* Proactive and committed working style, combined with a high level of adaptability and initiative 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
Clinical Research Associate I (CRA I) / Klinischer Monitor – Full-Time or Part-Time Available (m/w/d)

Job available in 13 locations: Bremen, Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Leipzig, Bonn, Ulm, Frankfurt, Remote, Aachen, Dresden, Stuttgart, Munich, Berlin

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our clinical department defines, develops and delivers clinical programmes. Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end-to-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and implement high-quality, cost-efficient clinical studies.

The role can be home-based, office-based in Munich or Karlsruhe, or hybrid, and is offered as a permanent full time (1 FTE) or part-time position (0.8 FTE / 80%).

The CRA:

- Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.
- Conducts remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation..
- Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability.
- Ensures audit readiness.
- Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites.
- Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to role are outlined in the task matrix.
- Travel up to 50-75%

A day in the Life:

- Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
- Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.
- Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
- Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.
- Brings up observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.
- May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
- Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.
- Participates in the investigator payment process.
- Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution.
- Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable
- Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.
- Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS).
- Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
- Participates in investigator meetings as necessary.
- Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
- Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
- Gives to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
- Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
- Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
- Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
- Gives to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
- Previous experience in a clinical environment with exposure to clinical research, healthcare or clinical trials that provides the knowledge and skills required to perform the role
- Valid driver's license
- Full Right to work in Germany
- Fluency in English and German language to at least C1 level (note that the interview will be held in German).

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Effective clinical monitoring skills
- Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
- Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical attitude, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and decision-making
- Ability to handles Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
- Effective oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
- Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
- Effective social skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Effective organizational and time management skills
- Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
- Ability to work in a team or independently as required
- Good computer skills: proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
- Good presentation skills

Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment. / Schwerbehinderte Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt behandelt.

Accelerate your career.

To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is your place to thrive, challenge the status quo, make a difference and grow in a team of pioneers who share your passion for technology.

What part will you play?

- Identify key risks related to Siemens’s AI activities – in internal processes as well as in our products, covering technical, operational, contractual and regulatory aspects.- Support the continuous evolution of AI governance at Siemens.- Design and execute comprehensive audit programs and controls to address the identified risks.- Enhance and challenge existing audit techniques, e.g. by driving the responsible and effective use of AI in audit and lifting the potential from automation and data analytics.- Independently drive assurance objectives, define and align conclusions and recommended improvements to implement change (as necessary) in the organization.- Drive meetings with auditees and key stakeholders to present the team’s conclusions and recommended improvements.- Actively contribute to shaping the future of audit in the age of AI.- Build and maintain your network in various Siemens businesses and functions.- Conduct your audit engagements using FIN A’s Agile Audit Framework.

What you need to make real what matters.

- Proven track record of career development including several years of professional experience within Siemens, or a technology company, or a respected assurance and consulting firm.- Strong academic history with a degree (Master or Ph.D.) in AI, data science, statistics, economics or related fields.- A passion for getting AI right, i.e. facilitating innovation and speed responsibly.- Deep expertise and hands-on experience with at least one of the following areas:- Developing AI solutions in different configurations (training ML models, utilizing foundation models, monitoring them in production), ideally in industrial settings, critical infrastructure or financial services.- Testing or certifying AI systems, devising AI governance, formulating technical standards for AI in industrial settings.
- Experience with AI deployments in the cloud.- Understanding of IT risk management (e.g., IAM, DR/BC) and assurance principles.- Certifications like ISACA AI Audit or IAPP AI Governance Professional are a plus.- Strong desire and drive to develop into a business or functional role after 3-5 years in audit.- Excellent communication skills to summarize and describe technical audit results for senior stakeholders.- Proficiency in English, flexibility to travel (up to 30%, incl. international travel) and embracing our hybrid working model is essential.

What we offer.

- A hybrid working model comprising 2 to 3 days of working from the office per week- Attractive remuneration package and relocation (if needed)- FIN A Grow & Development program for both professional and personal growth- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for you and your family- Find more benefits here (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs.html)

jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM Center for QuantumEngineering (ZQE)
jobs.description:
The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.

GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.

Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growth
Structural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffraction
Investigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sources
Determination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)
Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbH
Supervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the project
Writing scientific publications for peer-reviewed journals
Presentation of results at national and international conferences

Completed doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field
Solid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solids
Knowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)
Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperatures
Experience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostats
Demonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials science
Independent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantage
Experience supervising students is an advantage
We offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.
TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.
Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.

Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the X-Labs department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Internship in Flight Control Systems (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Systems Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the X-Labs department, as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 6 months
- 
Within the X-Labs organization, we are targeting advanced technological breakthroughs that could be key enablers of the next generation products at Airbus.

By exploration of new air vehicle concepts and application of disruptive technology bricks we are driving a step change in air vehicle performance and allowing us to significantly rethink air vehicle design. These advances are opening up the design space and enabling us to look at new concepts and new markets previously impossible to envisage.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Flight Controls Engineering Intern to join our dynamic flight systems team. In this role, you will gain invaluable hands-on experience designing, testing, and integrating advanced flight control systems for our next-generation aircraft. Mentored by senior engineers, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects, applying theoretical aerospace concepts to real-world hardware and software challenges.

- Flight Control Law Development & Simulation: Assist in the design, modeling, and refinement of flight control laws to meet performance and handling requirements.
- Develop FCC dynamic algorithms: Design and optimize dynamic algorithms for the Flight Control Computer (FCC) to ensure reliable aircraft responsiveness.
- Implement control strategies in MATLAB/Simulink: Translate aerodynamic data and control theory into high-fidelity digital models.
- Conduct Software-In-The-Loop (SIL) simulations to validate control architecture stability: Run rigorous tests to analyze system performance and safety margins.
- Hardware: Lead trade studies to evaluate, select, and integrate core flight control hardware for your specific project scope, ensuring seamless communication between sensors, actuators, and the FCC.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) within Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
- Language skills: English Fluent, good German skills would be an advantage.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Previous project team experience (e.g., Design Build Fly, Formula SAE, university rocketry/UAV teams).
- Familiarity with simulation environments like Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).
- Exposure to hardware integration, avionics, or basic embedded systems.
- Eagerness to learn and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Stellenbeschreibung:
About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.

You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.

We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.

Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.

What You’ll Do

- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.
- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.
- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.
- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.
- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.
- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.
- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.
- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.

What We’re Looking For

- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.
- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.
- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.
- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.
- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.
